SERIAL_DEPENDENCY.meaning: downstream task waits for named prerequisite tasks/artifacts

INDEPENDENT_PARALLEL.meaning: independent tasks become ready together when their own inputs are ready

FAN_OUT_FAN_IN.meaning: multiple branches execute independently, then a declared synthesis task consumes all required branches

CONSULTATIVE_ADVICE.meaning: consultant emits advisory artifact/evidence; decision authority remains with named owner

COMPETITIVE_CANDIDATES.meaning: two or more independent candidate tasks emit alternatives into a decision_group

STRUCTURED_CRITIQUE_AND_REVISION.meaning: proposal/candidate artifact is critiqued and a bounded revision artifact is emitted before decision

OWNER_ADJUDICATION.meaning: authorized owner/adjudicator consumes candidates/reviews and emits durable selection/merge/rejection result

QUORUM_OR_PANEL_REVIEW.meaning: independent reviews are collected before a declared meta-review or gate decision

reliability: stale downstream invalidation after upstream digest/version change
candidate generation does not bypass promotion/release gates
hard truth rights provenance and release gates remain fail closed
